title: Frozen Vinyl Player
body:
"Plays all sorts of records! Emits across your entire property."


The Frozen Vinyl Player comes form The Gift of Frozen Beats. It is like any other vinyl player, I'm must be placed on a plot and this one comes in a few different shades of blue. When unboxed and placed down, A vinyl is already playing once you place it down. The vinyl that comes with the Frozen Vinyl Player is called Midnight Winter Vinyl.
